use_cases: Primary navigation panel for SaaS dashboards and web applications
Collapsible side menu to optimize screen space on smaller viewports
Navigation with notification badges showing unread counts
Responsive navigation with mobile hamburger menu toggle
Active state tracking for current page indication
ai_summary: A responsive, collapsible sidebar navigation component featuring a hamburger menu for mobile, expand/collapse functionality for desktop, notification badges on items, and active state management. Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Suitable for SaaS platforms, admin dashboards, and web applications requiring organized multi-section navigation.
